page.overview:
Who is Vargas?

Vargas is a minor antagonist in Final Fantasy VI. He is the son of Duncan Harcourt, a famed martial arts instructor in Figaro. Vargas resents fellow pupil Sabin, believing that his father favors Sabin over his own kin.

Vargas met Sabin when the latter was seventeen years old. They trained under Vargas's father, Duncan Harcourt, for years at Duncan's home near South Figaro and Mt. Kolts. Duncan's wife lived in another house in South Figaro. Over time, the arrogant Vargas believed Duncan favored Sabin and intended to name him heir to the family dojo, which infuriated him. At one point, he did not make much progress in his lessons, something that his father was disappointed with. Believing his father had snubbed him, Vargas spontaneously attacked Duncan during a training trip one day and beat him to the brink of death. Vargas believed he had killed his father, a rumor that spread across the region for two to three days. During that period, he fled to Mt. Kolts. knowing the twenty-seven-year-old Sabin would seek him out.

While Terra, Locke, and Edgar climbed Mt. Kolts to reach the Returner Hideout, they ran across Vargas at the summit after chasing his shadow. Believing Sabin had sent them, Vargas attacked them and tried to kill them. He only used unarmed attacks and Gale Cut. Sabin interrupted the fight and confronted Vargas about Duncan's death, insisting Vargas had misunderstood everything and Duncan intended to name Vargas his heir. Vargas's arrogance made him refuse to listen and used a special technique, the Blizzard Fist, to blast the others but Sabin back, and the two engaged in a one-on-one duel. Vargas used his Doom Fist to force Sabin into a battle of the death, a battle Sabin won when he unleashed a Blitz technique Raging Fist, stunning Vargas that he had already learned such a skill.

After the duel, Vargas is never seen or mentioned again by Sabin or the survived Duncan. From the ending of the battle and the way Vargas's sprite vanishes, it is not clear if he fled or if Sabin killed him.
